known_sources: SEC 8-K filed 2026-09-10 announcing CFO transition effective 2026-09-21
special_questions: Is OCS plus the National OCS Program becoming a durable transplant platform, or is growth increasingly dependent on a capital-intensive aviation/logistics network?
Can OCS Kidney, next-generation products and European logistics expansion extend growth while preserving clinical, regulatory and reimbursement advantages?
How should convertible debt, stock dilution and the large Somerville finance lease affect owner FCF and permanent-loss risk?
valuation_metric: Locked owner-FCF/share DCF. Historical multiple percentile is left null because the business mix changed materially with NOP/logistics expansion and current owner-FCF normalization is not comparable across the full five-year window.
intake_facts: FY2025 revenue was $605.494M and operating cash flow was $192.840M.
Q2 2026 revenue was $189.948M and H1 2026 revenue was $363.881M.
H1 2026 operating cash flow was $41.842M while capex was $43.749M.
June 30, 2026 cash was $472.675M; funded debt carrying values were approximately $454.260M convertible notes, $20.000M current debt and $39.743M long-term debt.
June 30, 2026 finance lease liability was $347.660M and common shares outstanding were 34.630M.
Q2 2026 diluted weighted-average shares were 40.709M, reflecting meaningful dilution from convertibles/equity instruments when dilutive.
2025 net income included a large tax benefit associated primarily with release of a deferred-tax valuation allowance and requires normalization review.
